name: Fluidomat Ltd
tagline: BSE: FLUIDOM | Microcap fluid-coupling manufacturer, Dewas, since 1971
business_overview: India's pioneer in hydrodynamic fluid couplings (fixed and variable-speed, scoop-control) for industrial and automotive drives up to 6000 KW. Prices at roughly 1/5th to 1/10th of key MNC peer Voith, giving it a structural cost advantage in an oligopoly market; roughly half of revenue is recurring replacement/spares business.
source_notes: Source sheet grouped it with High Energy Batteries as having 'notable discussion post engagement, though more questioning of growth.' The long-running ValuePickr thread ('Fluidomat - Where perfection meets technology') independently confirms this is a well-regarded, debt-free microcap with a genuine competitive moat.
fundamentals_table: Mar'26: Sales Rs 72 Cr, PAT Rs 20 Cr (EPS Rs 40.71) | Jun'26: Sales down to Rs 12 Cr, operating margin down to 25%
fundamentals_narrative: Strong multi-year track record (17-21% sales CAGR, 28-39% profit CAGR over 3-5 years) with excellent capital efficiency (ROCE 30%, ROE 23%) and no debt - genuinely high-quality numbers. But the most recent data shows real deceleration: TTM profit growth has turned negative (-10%), the latest reported quarter shows sales dropping sharply from the prior quarter, and Screener flags a serious working-capital red flag: debtor days up from 118 to 149, and total working capital days more than doubling from 239 to 411. That combination (slowing growth + deteriorating cash conversion) is a genuine near-term concern layered on top of an otherwise excellent long-term record.
technical_read: Weekly: MACD Level +3.28 (Sell - momentum has just turned down), RSI(14) 50.0 (neutral), moving averages mixed with shorter periods (10-20-30) turning Sell while longer periods (50-200) remain Buy - a stock consolidating/pulling back after a strong run. Monthly: MACD Level +53.33 but Sell action (still deeply positive but decelerating from a high level), RSI(14) 57.7 (neutral), all moving averages from 10 through 200-month remain firmly Buy. Read: the monthly trend remains a genuine, broad, long-term uptrend, but both timeframes show momentum cooling - directly consistent with the working-capital deterioration and TTM profit decline showing up in the fundamentals. This looks like a high-quality compounder taking a breather rather than a broken story, but the near-term signals (fundamental and technical) agree with each other on caution.
sentiment_summary: The ValuePickr thread ('Fluidomat - Where perfection meets technology') reflects durable, multi-year value-investor conviction built on the company's oligopoly-like competitive position and pricing advantage versus MNC peer Voith, plus the recurring-revenue quality of its spares business. This is a well-vetted, long-tenured community favorite rather than a fresh speculative name - which makes the recent working-capital and growth deceleration more notable, not less, since it's a departure from an otherwise well-understood quality-compounder pattern.
bse_notes: No SEBI action or pledging found. Stable, meaningful promoter holding (53.45%) with a long dividend-paying history (~17-18% payout).
